# Changelog

What changed in OpenBGA Toxicology LIMS, newest release first. Changes not yet in a
release are listed under Unreleased. Within a release, changes are ordered by impact, then
newest first. The application shows the same list under **What's new**.

## Unreleased (2026-11-12 to 2026-11-20)

### High impact

- **Changed:** Choose the patient of a new order from one search box (2026-11-18)

  **New order** now starts with **Who is the order for?**: one box finds patients by name, birth date or identifier as you type, and each row shows the birth date with the age, sex, identifiers and the patient's last order. Click a row, or use the arrow keys and Enter, to go on to the order details. The patients you entered orders for recently are one click away, **Register patient** sits right under the results, and the exact searches are folded under **Exact search**. The patient find on **Patients** and the **Find** on **Orders** also match an exact birth date (YYYY-MM-DD).

  Technical notes:

  New audited query `find_order_patients` (order-entry authority; audit action `order.find_patients`, recording only whether find text was used and the counts). No database migration.

- **Changed:** Enter a new order in two steps that follow the requisition (2026-11-18)

  The **New order** form is split into two steps. **Requisition** holds the ordering source and the authority to test, with one **Next: Tests**; **Tests** holds the tests, with sequence role and reflex testing on one row and a link to apply the first test's choices to all, and small buttons with counts for diagnoses, medications, point-of-care results, standing authority and order billing. **Back: Requisition** keeps everything entered, an **Order summary** on the right shows what is still missing, and **Save order** works once it is complete. An empty order billing is a warning, not a block; **Add order billing** opens it on the saved order. Short choices such as **Received as**, **Billing responsibility** and **As supplied** are rows of buttons, with a **?** that explains the field, and **First-line test** now reads **First-line (screen)**. **Change patient** is a link in the patient box, and the trail at the top of New order, Receive specimens and Finish receipt shows its steps as pills: done in green with a check, the current one in blue. Tests are found with one search at the top of **Tests**, and each chosen test is a row with its name, its choices and **×**.

- **Changed:** The project is licensed under AGPL-3.0-only (2026-11-17, [#112](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/112))

  The application is now licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License version 3 only, with the copyright and trademark notice of BGASoft Inc. and OpenBGA contributors in the README, NOTICE, website, installer metadata and release notes.

  Technical notes:

  - `LICENSE` is the unmodified AGPLv3 text; the Cargo workspace, npm packages, lockfile, Tauri bundle and dependency policy use the `AGPL-3.0-only` identifier.
  - Builds published earlier remain under GPL-3.0-only.
  - The documentation now describes AGPLv3 section 13 for network use, and the notice states that the product name, OpenBGA and their logos are trademarks of BGASoft Inc. that the license does not grant (section 7(e)).

### Medium impact

- **Changed:** The Windows installer lists duplicate earlier installations (2026-11-20)

  When a Windows computer has more than one installation under an earlier product name (Vibe Tox LIS, OpenBGA Tox or Steady State LIMS) in different folders, the installer still stops, but its message now lists each installation with its version and folder, names the one to keep and tells you to remove the others in Windows Settings › Apps › Installed apps. Leave **Delete the application data** unchecked when uninstalling; the laboratory data is then not removed. The installer does not uninstall anything itself.

  Technical notes:

  The NSIS pre-install hook collects every validated former registration and keeps the newest version (the most recent product name on equal versions). The downgrade check now runs once against the kept installation.

- **Changed:** Receive specimens is simpler, and New order goes straight to it (2026-11-19)

  In **New order**, **Accept order and receive specimens** saves the order, accepts it and opens **Receive specimens** on the same page. Pressing the button is the explicit acceptance; an order that cannot be accepted, or whose billing was asked for next, opens on its page as before.

  **Receive specimens** now has one summary line (patient, order, client, ordering practitioner) and three numbered boxes. **Tests for this material** chooses the only waiting test for you. In **Collection**, the date and time start empty; **Time not on the requisition** and **Date not on the requisition** replace the old dropdown, and the laboratory's time zone is one press away. **Specimens received** has one row per specimen, filled in from the tests' specimen types, with mL to start and **Measured**, **Estimated** or **Unknown** for the volume. **Next** and **Order** sit beside the boxes. **Receive specimens** works once the line beside it says nothing is missing.

- **Added:** A report's Delivery tab lists its messages sent through Interfaces (2026-11-18)

  The **Delivery** tab of a report now also lists the report's messages through Interfaces: HL7 results sent over MLLP, files written to a folder, and unrouted messages with the decision recorded in **Unrouted messages**. Each row shows the connection, the revision, the status as Interfaces records it, such as **Accepted (AA)**, **Written** or **Delivery recorded another way**, and the time, and opens the message in **Interfaces › Logs**. The section is shown to people who can open Interfaces, and its rows are not counted as handed off.

  Technical notes:

  `list_partner_messages` takes an optional `reportId`: only the outgoing messages of that report, its revisions and withdrawal notice, unrouted ones included. It needs configuration authority, as before.

- **Added:** A summary of the report on the report page (2026-11-18, [#125](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/125))

  The report page has a **Summary** with the client, ordering practitioner, specimen, tests, collection time, release, last export and **Impact after release**, shown as **Nothing open** or the number of open items. The patient banner links to the accession and, for people who enter orders, to the order with **View order**.

- **Changed:** Find a report by its accession number or any part of its number (2026-11-18, [#124](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/124))

  **Find** on **Reports** now matches the accession number and any part of the report number, in upper or lower case, not only the start of the report number.

- **Added:** Preview any revision of a report and export an earlier one (2026-11-18, [#126](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/126))

  The **Preview** tab shows the report content without exporting it. Pick an earlier revision to see it marked **Superseded** and export it with **Export revision N**; **Export PDF** at the top always exports the current revision.

- **Changed:** Report delivery shows each destination's status as a badge (2026-11-18, [#126](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/126))

  The **Delivery** tab lists each destination with its method, status, time and person. The status is a colored badge, and a blocked destination shows its reason. The tab also shows how many destinations are handed off, with **Open in Delivery** and **Add destination**.

- **Added:** See every row of an import attempt and what happened to it (2026-11-18)

  An import attempt in **Result imports** now opens on a **Rows** tab listing each row as received: record, sample label, test code, analyte, value and what happened to it (New result, Duplicate, Reprocessed, QC row, Quarantined or Measured, not ordered (kept)). A patient row links to its results in **Result review** and a QC row to its run's QC review. Filter the rows with **What happened**, or click a count under **Outcome** to show just those rows.

  Technical notes:

  Results migration 10 adds the append-only table `res_import_rows`, written by each new import attempt. Attempts imported before this version list no rows; their counts are unchanged. `get_import_attempt` returns the rows in a new `rows` field.

- **Changed:** The report page shows its status under the title and keeps one main button (2026-11-18, [#125](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/125))

  Under a report's title, chips show its availability, **Final** or **Partial**, the revision and its type, and **Handed off X of Y** for delivery. **Export PDF** is the only main button; **Prepare next revision**, **Add destination** and **Withdraw report** are under **More actions**, with Withdraw report last.

- **Changed:** The report page shows the results and arranges its sections in tabs (2026-11-18, [#126](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/126))

  A report opens on **Results**, which lists each analyte with its result, units, limits and comparison. **Preview**, **Delivery**, **Revisions**, **PDF exports** and **Impact** are tabs with a count, and **Incidents** appears when the report has one.

- **Changed:** Incomplete identity intake: required supplied text and readable labels (2026-11-17, [#106](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/106))

  The exact supplied date or age text is required for a partial date or supplied age and is checked before saving. Birth information and status read plainly in the form and the list, for example Partial date: 1985 or Supplied age: About 40, with Awaiting verified identity, Resolved and Declined as badges.

- **Added:** Incomplete identity intake: side panel, Find and Show filter (2026-11-17, [#106](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/106))

  An intake opens in the side panel with Previous and Next, and the page has **Find** by the name as supplied or the source reference, a **Show** filter with counts (awaiting, resolved, declined, all), a Waiting column and a row menu with **Open**, **Resolve with verified patient**, **Record declined intake** and **View in audit trail**.

- **Added:** Patient page shows Identity history for a resolved incomplete intake (2026-11-17, [#107](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/107))

  A patient who was chosen to resolve an incomplete intake has an **Identity history** section with the intake reference, what was supplied, birth information, who resolved it and when, and a link to the audit trail.

  Technical notes:

  `get_subject` returns `resolvedIntakes` on the patient's existing audited read.

- **Changed:** QC requiring review lists one readable item per run (2026-11-17, [#108](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/108))

  The QC requiring review queue now lists one item per run, named by method, instrument and date, with the analytes counted by status, for example 3 analytes not assessed. The item opens the run's QC review, and the queue counts runs.

- **Added:** Work queue for incomplete identity intake (2026-11-17, [#108](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/108))

  The Front desk queue **Incomplete identity intake** lists intake awaiting a verified identity, oldest first, with the next action to get the complete birth date and resolve. The navigation item shows the same count.

- **Changed:** Work queues hides empty queues and adds an Area filter and column (2026-11-17, [#108](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/108))

  **Work queues** hides queues with nothing waiting (**Show empty queues** brings them back) and has an **Area** filter, remembered for each person, and an Area column. A queue that has not been counted yet reads Not counted yet with an explanation, and shows its count after you open it.

- **Changed:** Billing handoff files are named with the handoff ID and accession (2026-11-12, [#103](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/103))

  **Export file** in Billing handoffs saves `bh-<handoff ID>_<accession>.json`. A handoff with several accessions uses the lowest one followed by `_plus<n>`, and an existing file is never replaced.

  Technical notes:

  - Billing JSON connections gain the placeholders `{handoff_id}` and `{accession}`; `{handoff}` or `{handoff_id}` is required. New connections default to `bh-{handoff_id}_{accession}.json`.
  - Saved patterns are not migrated and keep writing the same names.
  - Interfaces Logs shows the accession as the message's source label; searching by handoff number still works.

- **Added:** Enable and disable analyzers from the Analyzer listeners window (2026-11-12, [#102](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/102))

  The Analyzer listeners window now has Enable and Disable for each analyzer, and Enable all and Disable all, for people who manage analyzers. A change that would interrupt an analyzer sending results or an open run asks for confirmation, and the window then reports which analyzers started listening and which did not, with the reason.

- **Changed:** Logs say which interface contract check holds a message (2026-11-12, [#99](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/99))

  A message held by its connection's acceptance gate now says which check holds it: contract not approved, tests not run, tests failed or tests out of date. **Open interface contract** in the Details opens the connection's contract dialog.

  Technical notes:

  The reason is computed when read and never stored, so there is no migration.

### Low impact

- **Changed:** Choose Compact, Default or Wide navigation width (2026-11-20)

  The … menu at the top of the navigation now offers Compact, Default and Wide instead of Narrower navigation, Wider navigation and Reset navigation width, with a check mark on the width in use. Default is a little wider than before and is the width the navigation opens with the first time. Dragging the right edge still sets any width in between, and the width is remembered across restarts.

  Technical notes:

  The saved navigation layout (`vibe-tox.navigation.layout-v1` in the webview's local storage) gains a `preset` field. A layout saved without it at the old 256-pixel first-start width opens at Default (288 pixels); any other saved width is kept.

- **Added:** Collapse all navigation areas with one button (2026-11-20)

  A Collapse all sections button beside … at the top of the navigation closes every open area at once, including the current page’s, which stays highlighted. It shows only while an area is open.

- **Changed:** The user menu groups account security and puts Lock now and Sign out last (2026-11-20)

  In the menu that opens from your name, Change password, Security keys and **Unlock PIN settings**
  (formerly Unlock PIN) now sit under an **Account security** heading, each with its own icon.
  Appearance, About this app and the version follow, and **Lock now** and **Sign out** are at the
  bottom, after a line, with Sign out last.

- **Added:** The user menu shows who is signed in and their roles (2026-11-20)

  The menu that opens from your name at the top right now starts with your name and your roles,
  such as Accessioner, Analyst, or **All roles** when you hold every role. It is information only,
  so you can check which account is signed in before you work.

  Technical notes:

  `current_session` (`SessionInfo`) adds `roleLabels`: the short names of `roles`, in the same order.

- **Changed:** Finish receiving shows each specimen's next step in one box (2026-11-19)

  The accession page is now titled **Finish receiving** with the accession number. The patient strip also names the order (a link), the client and the tests. Each specimen card shows its status, the receipt progress and one box with the next step: the label to scan with **Record receipt decision** and **Print labels**, or, once decided, where work continues. **Collection** and **Order billing** move to a side column, where **Collection history** and **Open order billing** open in a dialog. **Check label status** is replaced by **Updated** with the time the page was read and **Refresh**, as on the order page.

- **Changed:** Report availability has its own color (2026-11-18, [#124](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/124))

  **Availability** shows **Current** in green, **Superseded** in gray and **Withdrawn** in red, so a withdrawn report stands out in the list and on the report and revision pages.

- **Changed:** Searchable form fields can be emptied with a clear button (2026-11-18)

  A searchable choice in a form, such as **Client** or **Ordering practitioner** in **New order**, shows a clear button while it holds a value, like the other dropdowns in forms.

- **Added:** Clear a chosen value in form dropdowns (2026-11-17, [#110](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/110))

  In forms, a dropdown with a value shows an X while the pointer is on it or it has keyboard focus; selecting the X, or pressing Delete or Backspace, clears the value. A required field shows its usual message on save. Filters on lists are unchanged.

- **Added:** Hover the Tests count in Orders to see the ordered tests (2026-11-13, [#101](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/101))

  Hovering or focusing the Tests count shows a tooltip titled N tests ordered with each test's name and code. The count and its sorting are unchanged.

- **Changed:** Orders column renamed Order received (2026-11-13, [#101](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/101))

  The Orders column showing when the laboratory received the order is now **Order received**, so it is not mistaken for a specimen receipt. Date format and sorting are unchanged.

- **Changed:** Audit trail By column names the instrument that acted (2026-11-12, [#104](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/104))

  **By** shows the instrument's name, for example AU simulator serial (instrument), and the CSV and PDF export show the same. An instrument that cannot be found keeps its kind and ID.

- **Changed:** Logs Refresh, resolved unrouted messages and readable Waiting since (2026-11-12, [#98](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/98))

  **Logs** has **Refresh** and an Updated time that keep filters, tab and search. A resolved unrouted message no longer shows the yellow Not sent warning; its Application column says how it was decided. In **Unrouted messages**, Waiting since is wider and wraps instead of being cut off.

- **Changed:** Quieter copy hint on the version in the user menu (2026-11-12, [#104](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/104))

  The copy hint next to the version is now a small icon, clearer on hover or focus, and Copied appears briefly in the same style. The whole row still copies the version.

## 0.1.2 (2026-10-26 to 2026-11-17)

### High impact

- **Changed:** The application is named OpenBGA Toxicology LIMS (2026-11-17, [#113](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/113))

  The application, its window titles, installers, website and documentation use the name **OpenBGA Toxicology LIMS**, with the full-name lockup on the sign-in card and top bar. Existing installations and data carry over without changes to stored records or credentials.

  Technical notes:

  - Download filenames are `toxicology-lims_<version>_<os>-<arch>.<ext>`. New recovery kit files use `toxicology-lims-recovery-kit-` and new exit-export folders `toxicology-lims-exit-`; older names stay valid because readers do not depend on the prefix.
  - The data folder, bundle identifier, executable name (`lis-desktop`), key-store and security-key identities, saved preference keys and data formats are unchanged. Credentials are not rotated and stored records are not rewritten.
  - The Windows installer migrates a recognized earlier per-user installation: it keeps its directory, moves matching shortcuts and retires the old uninstall entry. Ambiguous installations or a different chosen directory stop the installation for manual reconciliation. Application data is never removed.
  - The Debian package declares Conflicts, Replaces and Provides for the earlier package names so the new package can take over `lis-desktop`.

- **Security:** Bundled SQLite updated to 3.54.1 (2026-11-11, [#89](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/89))

  The bundled SQLite is updated to version 3.54.1, which fixes an advisory where a database opened with a crafted write-ahead log file of a different page size could return uninitialized memory.

  Technical notes:

  - `rusqlite` 0.40.2 to 0.41.1 and `libsqlite3-sys` 0.38.2 to 0.39.1 (advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0459). The minimum SQLite version in the coding standards is now 3.54.0.
  - The storage layer's transaction-control guard was adapted to the new API with unchanged behavior.

- **Added:** Warning before a lot expires, with a Lots expiring soon work queue (2026-11-09, [#78](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/78))

  **Operations settings** has a new Lots setting, **Warning before a lot expires** (1-365 days, default 14). Lots inside that period appear in the **Lots expiring soon** work queue, show an Expires in N days badge in the Lots list, and trigger a warning, without blocking, when chosen for a new run. Expired lots stay blocked as before.

  Technical notes:

  Runtime settings migration 6 adds the column; earlier settings versions take the default of 14 days.

- **Added:** Interface contracts and acceptance tests for partner connections (2026-11-08, [#74](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/74))

  Each partner connection keeps a versioned **interface contract** drafted from the terms agreed with the partner and approved by a second person. No patient data is sent or received until a contract version is approved and the latest synthetic acceptance tests passed for the connection as it is now. A new contract or mapping version, or a change to the settings that shape the messages, makes the tests out of date and the connection waits until they pass again.

  Technical notes:

  - Existing connections wait after the upgrade until a contract is approved and the tests pass.
  - Waiting deliveries show the reason in Logs; folder and SFTP order intake does not read, and the MLLP listener does not listen, until the gate is open.
  - Interfaces migration 0015 adds contracts, drafts, acceptance runs and an `acceptance_key` column (contract version, mapping version and a digest of the message-shaping settings).
  - New commands `draft_partner_contract`, `approve_partner_contract` and `run_partner_acceptance_tests`; runs are audited.

- **Added:** Reject held order messages by hand and resolve rejections (2026-11-08, [#75](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/75))

  In **Logs**, the row menu has **Reject** for an order message that is waiting for its patient or held for review, and **Mark resolved** for a rejected message, each with a note. A rejection stays under the **Rejected** tab until someone resolves it; a resolved one moves to All and its Details record who resolved it and when.

  Technical notes:

  - Interfaces migration 0016 adds the append-only table `ifc_partner_rejection_resolutions`; the note is 1-500 characters.
  - New audited commands `reject_received_message` and `resolve_partner_rejection`, which need the configuration-management capability. A manually rejected message never becomes an order, and the clinic is not told.

- **Added:** Export the audit trail as CSV or PDF (2026-11-06, [#59](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/59))

  **Export** in the Audit trail header writes every event that matches the filters, not only the loaded page, to Downloads: **CSV, for analysis** or **PDF, for printing**. The PDF lists the laboratory, filters, export time, exporter and event count, and marks each page as confidential when it contains patient information.

  Technical notes:

  - Limits: 50,000 events for CSV and 2,000 for PDF; above them nothing is written and the page asks to narrow the filters.
  - Each export is recorded in the Security stream as `Export events`.
  - Needs both the audit-view and the export capability (Auditor and Administrator roles today). Adds the report template `audit-export` version 1.

- **Added:** Receive HL7 orders over MLLP on the lab network (2026-11-06, [#73](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/73))

  HL7 Orders connections can use **MLLP - LIS listens**: the clinic's interface connects to the LIS on the lab network and sends order messages, and the LIS answers each one with an acknowledgement after the message is saved. AA means the message was kept (order made, waiting for its patient, held for review, or a replay), AE a content error, and AR another sender or an unreadable or unsupported message.

  Technical notes:

  - Settings: listen address and port, partner addresses allowed (1-20, each with an optional note), acknowledgement, character set (UTF-8) and idle timeout (10-3600 s, default 300). **Test listener** checks the port.
  - The listen address and every partner must be lab-network IP addresses; `0.0.0.0` and internet addresses are refused. There is no TLS in this version.
  - Connections from other addresses are closed and counted; summaries are audited at most once a minute per address. Limits: 4 partner connections per listener, 1 MiB per message.
  - A port in use or an address the computer does not have shows the connection as Not listening and is retried every 5 seconds.
  - Table cells are now centered vertically in tall rows, and status columns share one width.

- **Added:** Receive HL7 orders from a folder or SFTP (2026-11-05, [#53](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/53))

  An HL7 Orders connection reads OML^O21 and ORM^O01 files from a folder or SFTP and creates orders as Received for a person to accept in Orders. An unknown patient waits for registration, and replays are ignored or held for review. Logs show the outcome of each received file.

  Technical notes:

  No ACK files are sent back. Order source kind `hl7_interface` is shown as "HL7 interface (EMR)".

- **Added:** Send HL7 results to a partner over MLLP on the lab network (2026-11-05, [#61](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/61))

  HL7 Results connections can use **MLLP - LIS connects**: the LIS connects to the partner's interface on the lab network, sends each ORU^R01 and reads the partner's application acknowledgement on the same connection. Logs show Sent, Accepted (AA), Rejected (AE or AR, with the partner's reason) and Awaiting application ACK; a message with no acknowledgement in time is sent again with the same control ID.

  Technical notes:

  - Settings: partner address, port, acknowledgement and ACK timeout (1-300 s, default 30). **Test connection** and **Send test message** work over MLLP.
  - The partner must be an IP address on the lab network (private, link-local or loopback, or IPv6 unique-local or link-local); server names and internet addresses are refused. There is no TLS; reach a remote partner through the lab's VPN or use SFTP.
  - Over MLLP, MSH-15 and MSH-16 are left empty; file delivery keeps NE/NE.
  - Interfaces migration 0012 rebuilds `ifc_partner_connections` (protocols `mllp_connect` and `mllp_listen`, MLLP settings as JSON) and adds `ack_code` and `ack_text` to deliveries.

- **Added:** Billing files to a partner folder with an Interfaces menu (2026-11-04, [#50](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/50))

  The **Interfaces** menu has Connections, Logs and Unrouted messages. A connection writes billing JSON files to a partner folder, with routing rules by client, practitioner NPI, location and test, a schedule and a file name pattern. Nothing with patient data is written until a destination check covers the current folder.

- **Added:** Report PDF and HL7 Results connections with code mappings (2026-11-04, [#51](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/51))

  Connections can now write released report PDFs byte for byte, and send HL7 Results (ORU^R01) with test code mappings, to a partner folder. A later report revision goes to every connection that received an earlier one, and a withdrawal notice follows.

  Technical notes:

  The HL7 encoder is project code with no new dependency.

- **Added:** Send partner files over SFTP (2026-11-04, [#52](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/52))

  Connections can deliver over SFTP as well as to a folder. The server is identified by its SHA256 fingerprint, sign-in uses an SSH key made for this installation or a password, and files are uploaded without replacing existing ones.

  Technical notes:

  Migration 0009 adds SFTP columns to `ifc_partner_connections` and the `ifc_sftp_identity` table. Adds russh 0.65.1 and russh-sftp 3.0.1; RSA-only servers are not supported. The LIS only connects out.

- **Added:** Correct and retire analytes with a reason and history (2026-11-02, [#36](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/36))

  Analytes can now be corrected and retired with a required reason, and each correction is kept in a history shown in the side panel. A code can change only while nothing uses the analyte. A retired analyte stays in existing records, is hidden from new pickers and is listed with **Show retired**.

  Technical notes:

  Migration `lis-catalog` 0008 adds `active` and `revision` to `cat_analytes` and the append-only `cat_analyte_history`. New commands `update_analyte`, `analyte_history` and `analyte_usage`; changes are audited as `catalog.update_analyte`.

- **Added:** Light, Dark or System appearance for each user (2026-11-02, [#37](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/37))

  The user menu has an **Appearance** choice of Light, Dark or System. It applies at once, follows the operating system when set to System, and is remembered for each account on this computer. Printing and report PDFs stay light.

  Technical notes:

  Adds the shell-only command `set_window_theme` for the window title bar. The choice is kept in the app's local storage for each account; no database change.

- **Added:** Billing handoffs page lists every handoff (2026-10-30, [#27](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/27))

  **Billing handoffs** lists every handoff, newest first, so acknowledged ones stay reachable with their items and outcome history. You can search by handoff number, accession number or date of service and load older handoffs.

  Technical notes:

  New audited read `list_billing_handoffs` requires the Billing role and records the number of rows searched and returned, not the search text.

- **Added:** Choose and preview report layouts under Report templates (2026-10-28, [#13](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/13))

  **Report templates** offers the Classic layout and the Standard, Compact and Results first layouts for the report PDF, with a preview built from synthetic content. An administrator saves a layout as a draft and a quality manager approves or rejects it. Issued reports keep the layout they were prepared with, and the released revision's provenance shows it.

  Technical notes:

  New commands record `report.draft_layout`, `report.approve_layout` and `report.reject_layout`. The new layouts are Typst templates with pinned digests; Classic (`tox-report` v3) stays the default until a layout is approved.

- **Added:** Check, download and install updates from Versions and updates (2026-10-27, [#11](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/11))

  **Versions and updates** has an **Available updates** tab that checks for official releases and nightly builds, downloads the package and installs it. Every installation still needs a recorded approval and a verified pre-update backup.

  Technical notes:

  Update packages are verified with a Minisign signature and signed version. The package workflow signs packages and publishes `latest.json` and `nightly.json` only when the secrets `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY` and `TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD` and the variable `TAURI_UPDATER_PUBKEY` are set; with only one set the build fails. The newest ten `nightly-<date>.<run>` releases are kept. Adds `tauri-plugin-updater` 2.14. Installation needs the manage-configuration capability and is audited as `ops.install_update`.

### Medium impact

- **Fixed:** In-app updates keep working after the repository is renamed (2026-11-13, [#105](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/105))

  Available updates stopped listing new builds after the project repository was renamed. Updates are found again, and packages are still installed only with the project's signature.

  Technical notes:

  - Builds from this version on read the repository named in the update feeds (`latest.json` and `nightly.json` now carry a `repository` field) and accept it for the download address.
  - For builds that predate this change, the feed also lists the newest nightly under each former repository name and publishes `latest-<owner>-<name>.json` copies with the nightly release.

- **Added:** Duplicate analyzer messages are listed in Result imports (2026-11-11, [#87](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/87))

  A file or message identical to an earlier one from the same instrument now appears in **Result imports** as **Duplicate - not imported**, with a page that links to the earlier attempt. A **Hide duplicates** filter leaves them out, and Retry import is refused for a duplicate.

  Technical notes:

  lis-results migration 0009 rebuilds `res_import_attempts` to allow the `duplicate` outcome and the link to the earlier receipt. Nothing is read or imported from a duplicate.

- **Changed:** Report file names use {report} for the report number and {accession} for the accession (2026-11-11, [#85](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/85))

  In file name patterns for Report PDF and HL7 Results connections, `{report}` is now the report number and is required together with `{revision}`. `{accession}` is the accession number alone and is optional.

  Technical notes:

  - Interfaces migration 0017 rewrites stored patterns from `{accession}` to `{report}`, so existing connections keep writing the same file names and keep their acceptance.
  - A new pattern that uses only `{accession}` and `{revision}` is refused.

- **Added:** Warn before closing or signing out with an unsaved page form (2026-11-11, [#86](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/86))

  Closing the application or signing out with a half-filled full-page form (such as New order, Receive specimens or Register patient) asks **Leave without saving?** first, and Cancel is the default so Enter keeps the page open. If work is also in progress, one quit warning lists both.

- **Fixed:** HL7 results send sex as a table 0001 code and a unique test control ID (2026-11-10, [#79](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/79))

  PID-8 in every HL7 message the LIS sends is a standard code: F, M, A, N, O or U from the recorded text, and empty when nothing is recorded. **Send test message** now uses a new MSH-10 each time (`TEST-` and a unique ID), and MSH-11 stays `T`. The patient record is unchanged.

- **Changed:** HL7 results wait when the patient has no identifier (2026-11-10, [#79](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/79))

  An HL7 result for a patient with no identifier is no longer sent with an empty PID-3. It waits, and Logs Details say to add an identifier on the patient's page; report release, PDF and billing deliveries are not affected. When the released report names no identifier, PID-3 carries the patient's active identifiers at send time.

  Technical notes:

  Adding an identifier after release opens the report's impact review, so the delivery goes after the review is recorded as no impact.

- **Changed:** Interfaces Logs CSV export follows the screen (2026-11-10, [#80](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/80))

  The CSV export now states the transport as sent (MLLP), uploaded (SFTP) or written, and the application column as the acknowledgement code, awaiting_ack, outcome_unknown or what a received order became. The partner's reason is in a new last column.

  Technical notes:

  The `attempts` column is renamed `failed_attempts` and the column `ack_text` is added at the end. Update any script that reads these columns by name or position.

- **Added:** Interfaces Logs: record links, test message filter and selected export (2026-11-10, [#80](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/80))

  In **Logs**, the Record value links to the report revision, report or billing handoff that was sent, and test messages carry a **Test** badge and are hidden by default (**Show test messages**). Rows have checkboxes so **Export N selected** writes only those rows, and search accepts several values separated by commas.

- **Added:** See the sent HL7 message and the partner's reply in Logs (2026-11-10, [#81](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/81))

  Selecting a sent message in **Logs** opens a panel with its control ID, the partner's answer (AA, AE or AR with the reason, or No answer), the message exactly as sent one segment per line, and the attempts. A whole control ID in the search finds its message.

  Technical notes:

  The panel shows the bytes kept at the first attempt and checks them against the stored digest; if they are missing or differ, the panel says so. Opening a message needs the configuration-management capability and is recorded as an `interfaces.get_message` access event.

- **Changed:** Connections that cannot read their folder or server show Error with the reason (2026-11-08, [#75](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/75))

  A started folder or SFTP connection whose latest reading failed shows status **Error**, and Last connection says why, for example the folder was not found or the server refused the sign-in. It returns to Active after the first reading that works. A refused order message no longer puts its connection in Error; it shows under Rejected.

- **Added:** Counts by state and a State filter in Host health (2026-11-08, [#77](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/77))

  Above the checks table, buttons show the count per state (Alert, Warning, OK) and a **State** field filters the list; the filter stays in the page address. **Health history** is now a button beside **Check now**.

- **Added:** Next action links in Host health (2026-11-08, [#77](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/77))

  Under Next action, an **Open** link goes to the page where the action is done, for example Backups, Restore tests or Versions and updates. People without the needed capability see the text only, and checks done outside the app have no link.

- **Added:** Accession column in Orders (2026-11-06, [#70](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/70))

  **Orders** shows an Accession column after Sample barcode. Each number opens its accession, several are comma-separated, and Not received yet shows when there is none. The column can be sorted.

  Technical notes:

  Specimens migration 0005 adds an index on `spc_accessions(order_id)`.

- **Added:** Audit events show which fields they changed (2026-11-06, [#59](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/59))

  Opening an audit event shows a **Changes** table with Field, Old and New values for patients, the laboratory profile, clients, locations, practitioners, analytes and instruments. Patient values are shown only to people allowed to see them; others see the field names with Hidden. Opening the table is itself recorded in the Access stream.

  Technical notes:

  Values are read from each record's own revision history; audit events still store no values.

- **Changed:** Audit trail Find searches readable names, not only record IDs (2026-11-06, [#59](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/59))

  **Find** in the Audit trail now looks up a record by instrument code or name, username, accession, report number, container label, order number, practitioner name or NPI, client name or code, billing handoff number and similar values. Type at least two characters, pick the record, and Record type follows your choice; the full Record ID still works. Patients are searched by name only for people who may see patient names.

  Technical notes:

  New engine query `find_audit_records`. Each search is recorded as an access event without the typed text.

- **Changed:** Audit trail opens on all streams with filters for days, who acted and outcome (2026-11-06, [#59](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/59))

  The **Audit trail** now opens on **All streams** and has a Stream column, so a change such as a laboratory profile update shows up when the page opens. Filters for the days recorded, who acted (anyone, people only, system only, or one user) and the outcome (Succeeded, Failed or Denied) combine with each other, and **Clear filters** resets them.

  Technical notes:

  - Audit migration 0004 adds the index `audit_events_by_time`; it changes no event or chain input.
  - **Verify chain** is unavailable on All streams because each stream keeps its own chain.
  - Filters are applied in the query before the 100-event page. Reading the trail is still recorded as an `access` event.

- **Added:** Filters and search in Result imports (2026-11-06, [#69](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/69))

  **Result imports** can be filtered by Outcome and by received-from and received-to days, and searched by sample label, accession, container label or file name. The list has a Received column, and the filters stay in the page address.

  Technical notes:

  - New database views `ifc_v_receipt_arrivals` (interfaces migration 0013) and `ana_v_qc_receipt_positions` (analytical migration 0009).
  - Searching is audited without the typed text.

- **Added:** Find in Orders by patient, barcode, accession, order number or client (2026-11-06, [#70](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/70))

  **Find** in Orders matches the start of the patient name, sample barcode, accession number, order number or client name, ignoring case. Paging and counts follow the search, Enter applies it at once so a scanned barcode shows its order, and the text stays in the page address.

  Technical notes:

  The search text is never logged or audited; `order.list` records only that a search was used.

- **Changed:** Jump to a month and a year in date pickers (2026-11-06, [#71](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/71))

  The date picker header now opens a list of months, and the month list header opens a list of years, so a birth date no longer needs many clicks. Limits such as the latest allowed day apply at every level, and arrow keys, Enter and Escape work throughout.

- **Added:** Result imports say where to fix each quarantine reason (2026-11-06, [#69](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/69))

  The panel of a quarantined row has **Where to fix** links: Worklist, Open runs or Container lookup for an unknown or ambiguous label, the run for a closed or failed run, the file template or instrument for unmapped codes, units or scale, and the existing result for a conflicting duplicate. Each open row also offers **Retry import** in its menu and panel.

- **Added:** Retry several quarantined result imports at once (2026-11-06, [#69](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/69))

  Quarantined attempts have checkboxes, **Select all quarantined** and **Retry selected**, which takes one reason. Each message is retried and audited separately; a refusal is shown and **Retry the rest** continues.

- **Added:** Warn about missing Billing NPI and Tax ID and link blocking billing flags (2026-11-06, [#72](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/72))

  The laboratory profile warns when Billing NPI or Tax ID is missing and says billing derivations are held until both are set. In a derivation's Flags, a **Fix in** column links each blocking flag to the page where it is resolved, and the Held message names the common fix.

- **Added:** Enable or disable listening for all instruments at once (2026-11-05, [#65](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/65))

  **Enable all** and **Disable all** in the Instruments page header change every instrument that would change, after a confirmation that lists them. A message then reports how many changed, which were refused and why, and any listener that could not start.

  Technical notes:

  Each instrument is changed through the existing enable command and gets its own `interface.set_enabled` audit event; listeners restart after each instrument.

- **Added:** Export the current revision's PDF from the report page (2026-11-05, [#64](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/64))

  The report page has an **Export PDF (revision N, current)** button next to Previous and Next, which asks for a Purpose and exports the current revision. PDF exports on the report page are listed newest first with revision state, purpose, who exported and the file name; an export is not a delivery.

- **Fixed:** Add-on requests require an authority reference and name each blocking gate (2026-11-03, [#44](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/44))

  An add-on with new authority now needs an authority reference when it is requested. When an order gate blocks an action, the message names the gate in plain words, and accepting an older add-on without a reference warns you to decline it and record a new request.

- **Changed:** Updates stop and restart analyzer listeners automatically (2026-11-03, [#49](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/49))

  Installing an update no longer requires disabling analyzers by hand. The update waits for messages in progress, stops the listeners, and starts them again after the restart. The sign-in screen reports how many analyzers are listening again and names any that did not start.

  Technical notes:

  New commands `stop_listeners_for_update` and `get_listener_restart`; the wait is up to 60 seconds. Instrument enabled settings are not changed.

- **Changed:** Accept QC for several analytes at once and explain Whole run (2026-11-02, [#43](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/43))

  On a run's QC review, select several analytes and choose **Accept QC** to assess them together, with each recorded and audited separately. Whole run is shown as optional in its own section, and a summary line counts accepted analytes.

- **Added:** Calendar buttons on date fields and a time picker for collection (2026-11-02, [#46](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/46))

  Every date field has a calendar button, and Collection also has hour and minute lists. Birth dates and the collection date cannot be set after today. Collection warns when the time is Unknown.

- **Changed:** Navigation areas start closed with a total of waiting work (2026-11-02, [#38](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/38))

  Every navigation area is closed after sign-in. A closed area shows the total of its queue counts, such as Review 4, and each entry shows its own count when opened. Choices are kept during the session, but an idle-lock unlock starts closed again.

- **Changed:** Instrument side panel shows every setting, live status and activity (2026-10-30, [#35](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/35))

  The instrument side panel now shows the connection settings, live status with the last error, result source, recent activity and who registered or changed the instrument, in groups you can collapse. **Result imports** can be filtered by instrument.

  Technical notes:

  Migration `lis-interfaces` 0005 adds created and changed user and time columns to `ifc_instruments`; analyzers registered earlier show "Not recorded". The last listener error is held in memory and clears on restart.

- **Changed:** Long popup forms are wider and grouped into sections (2026-10-30, [#33](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/33))

  Long forms such as Create user, Edit roles, Laboratory profile, Operations settings and Method draft open in a wider dialog with titled sections and fields side by side. The title and the Save and Cancel buttons stay in view while the fields scroll.

- **Added:** Resize the side panel and widen it for correction history (2026-10-30, [#34](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/34))

  Drag the left edge of a side panel, or focus it and use the arrow keys, to change its width. The width is remembered per page on this computer, and **Show correction history** widens the panel automatically so the Reason column is visible.

- **Fixed:** Keep the first key typed in a form field (2026-10-29, [#25](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/25))

  The first character typed in each text field was being lost, so "Test reason" was saved as "est reason". Fields now keep every character.

- **Changed:** Update in one step from Versions and updates (2026-10-29, [#24](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/24))

  **Update to version N** opens one dialog: confirm you reviewed the changes, confirm your identity with a password or security key, and the app downloads, backs up, approves and installs. A downloaded package is kept while you move between tabs, and **Available updates** opens first with a clear status. Approving a downloaded update from a security-key account now uses the key.

- **Fixed:** Register AU400/AU640 result sources from Bench setup (2026-10-28, [#17](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/17))

  The **Register source** dialog in Bench setup now works for AU400/AU640 analyzers. It shows the analyzer's wire settings read-only, asks for a unit with each two-digit test code, and shows the fixed sample ID and corrected-results values as facts.

- **Fixed:** Results that are already approved cannot be approved again (2026-10-27, [#6](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/6))

  On a specimen's Result review page, **Approve results** now sends only revisions without a current approval. When every current result is approved, the page says so and **Reject results** becomes **Withdraw approval**, which needs a reason. A repeat approval is refused instead of recording a second review.

- **Added:** Sample barcode column in Orders (2026-10-26, [#5](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/5))

  The Orders list has a **Sample barcode** column showing the label codes of each order's primary containers, so several orders for one patient are easy to tell apart. An order with no accessioned sample shows "None received". The column sorts in both directions.

  Technical notes:

  `OrderSummary` gains `sampleBarcodes`. No schema migration.

### Low impact

- **Changed:** Product mark and name on the sign-in card and top bar (2026-11-12, [#97](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/97))

  The sign-in card and the application's top bar show the test-tube mark with the product name and an An OpenBGA project line.

- **Fixed:** Concurrent reads of the same HL7 order file no longer record a duplicate receipt (2026-11-11, [#89](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/89))

  Two intake passes that read the same HL7 order file at once could record an extra duplicate receipt and compete to move the file. Intake passes now run one at a time.

- **Fixed:** Windows folders are shown without the \\?\ prefix (2026-11-11, [#84](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/84))

  Folders chosen for partner connections and instrument results are stored and shown in their usual form (`C:\...` or `\\server\share\...`), including in Overview, the Connections list and written paths in Logs.

  Technical notes:

  Folders stored earlier with the prefix keep working; the instrument folder-in-use check compares both forms.

- **Changed:** Accepted orders show in green and the Orders Find text is complete (2026-11-10, [#82](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/82))

  Accepted orders have a green badge and Rejected stays neutral. The Orders Find field is wider with a shorter placeholder, and every Find field shows its placeholder as a tooltip.

- **Fixed:** Awaiting application ACK appears only for MLLP connections the LIS sends to (2026-11-10, [#83](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/83))

  The Awaiting application ACK line, column and Waiting for acknowledgement card now apply only to **MLLP - LIS connects** connections, because folder and SFTP partners never send an application acknowledgement. The card is hidden when there are no such connections.

- **Changed:** Active and Approved badges are green and settings errors show under the field (2026-11-09, [#78](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/78))

  Active and Approved status badges are now green everywhere, neutral badges have a grey tint and border, and table columns in Lots, Instruments and the patient list share the width equally. An Operations settings error now appears under its own field.

- **Fixed:** Host health shows the full operating system name and one Keep awake value (2026-11-09, [#76](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/76))

  The This computer section now gives the same operating system name, version and edition as the support check, for example Windows 10 Enterprise 22H2 (build 19045). Keep awake is a single value, with since and problem code shown only when they exist.

- **Changed:** Refresh shows that it is running (2026-11-08, [#75](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/75))

  While a refresh runs, the arrows turn and the status reads Refreshing, and then Updated shows the new time with seconds. Rows on a connection's own Logs tab no longer reopen the connection.

- **Changed:** Recovery kit files are named with the date and kit number (2026-11-06, [#68](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/68))

  The save dialog proposes a recovery kit file name that includes the laboratory's local day and the kit number, so two exports on one day differ. The name keeps only the date if the kit number cannot be read.

  Technical notes:

  Name form: `toxicology-lims-recovery-kit-<YYYY-MM-DD>-kit<N>.txt`. Readers do not depend on the file name, so older files stay valid.

- **Added:** Show the app version in the user menu (2026-11-05, [#62](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/62))

  The last line of the user menu shows the running version, for example Version 0.1.2. Selecting it copies the version and the menu shows Copied.

- **Changed:** Succeeded outcomes show as green success badges (2026-11-05, [#60](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/60))

  A successful result such as Succeeded in the Audit trail, Verified for backup runs, restore tests and exit exports, and Processed for result imports now appears as a green badge instead of a grey one. Failed stays red and Denied amber. Steady states such as Active or Approved stay neutral.

- **Fixed:** Version numbers in Report templates History no longer look like links (2026-11-05, [#63](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/63))

  In **Report templates** History, Version N looked clickable but opened nothing. It is now plain text.

- **Fixed:** Connected serial analyzer uses the Listening badge style (2026-11-02, [#39](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/39))

  A connected serial analyzer no longer looks disabled. Its status uses the same informational badge as Listening, and the top-bar summary does too while any analyzer is working.

- **Changed:** Corrections that change nothing are refused (2026-11-02, [#40](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/40))

  Correct practitioner, Correct client, Correct location and Change profile now refuse a save that changes no value, with "Nothing was changed". No version, history entry or audit event is written.

- **Changed:** Instrument pages link to each other and show the result source (2026-11-02, [#47](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/47))

  Laboratory setup > Instruments and Bench setup > Instruments now each show what the other owns and link to the same instrument. After registering an analyzer, the confirmation offers the next steps.

- **Fixed:** Sample label is marked required for control and calibrator lots (2026-11-02, [#45](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/45))

  In Register lot, Sample label shows as required for Control and Calibrator lots and is hidden for Reagent and Internal standard lots.

- **Fixed:** Volume fields are marked required when receiving specimens (2026-11-02, [#41](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/41))

  In Receive specimens, "Volume is" now comes first. Choosing Measured or Estimated marks Volume and Volume unit as required and highlights them if empty. Unknown clears and disables both.

- **Fixed:** A released report that is up to date shows as current (2026-10-30, [#28](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/28))

  After **Release report** succeeds, the workspace now shows "Revision N is current" with a link to the report and delivery instead of a red blocked banner. Content as it would print links to the revision as issued.

- **Changed:** Breadcrumbs on work queue, Run QC review and Health history pages (2026-10-30, [#32](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/32))

  Pages opened from another page now have a breadcrumb back, in the same place as on the patient page. The "All queues", "Open run" and "Host health" buttons are replaced by it.

- **Fixed:** Each repeated gate reason is shown once (2026-10-30, [#30](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/30))

  When the same reason applied several times, for example a collection time corrected more than once after release, it was listed repeatedly. It now appears once.

- **Fixed:** Forms show a refusal's reason even when no field holds it (2026-10-30, [#31](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/31))

  A form refused for a value that is not on the form used to say "Check the highlighted fields" with nothing highlighted. It now shows the real reason. Errors on a whole list, such as no test codes in Register source, appear under the list and move focus to it.

- **Added:** Close run asks for a reason (2026-10-29, [#26](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/26))

  Closing a run now requires a **Reason**, which is recorded in the audit trail and shown beside the closing time on the run page. Runs closed earlier without a reason show the time alone.

- **Fixed:** Import attempts say when a whole message or file was held (2026-10-29, [#20](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/20))

  When a whole analyzer message or result file is refused, the import attempt page now says "The whole message was held" or "The whole file was held" with the row count, instead of "No rows were quarantined". A file's **Quarantined** tab count matches the Outcome.

- **Fixed:** Invalid fields turn red and clear as soon as they are edited (2026-10-28, [#18](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/18))

  When a form is saved with a required field empty, the field's name, border and message turn red, including dropdowns and their placeholder. The error clears as soon as you edit the field rather than after you leave it.

- **Changed:** Work queues open sorted by most recent item first (2026-10-28, [#14](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/14))

  The Work queues overview now opens sorted by **Oldest item waiting**, most recent first. Queues with nothing waiting stay at the bottom. Clicking the header sorts oldest first, then returns to the standard order, then back to most recent first.

- **Changed:** A refused NPI says which rule failed (2026-10-27, [#12](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/12))

  An NPI with the wrong length or a non-digit is refused with "The NPI must be exactly 10 digits.", and one that fails the check digit with a message asking you to check for a typo. Every NPI field shows the hint "10 digits. The last digit is checked automatically."

- **Changed:** Confirmation and error notices appear in the top-right corner (2026-10-27, [#9](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/9))

  Pop-up notices such as "Laboratory profile saved" now appear in the top-right corner, just under the top bar, instead of the bottom-right where they could cover buttons.

- **Changed:** Searchable dropdowns open on a click and match simple dropdowns (2026-10-27, [#8](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/8))

  A click anywhere in a searchable dropdown such as Client or Ordering practitioner now opens its list, as simple dropdowns do. The arrow looks the same in both kinds of dropdown.

## 0.1.1 (2026-10-22 to 2026-10-23)

### Medium impact

- **Fixed:** People are shown by display name instead of internal user ID (2026-10-23, [#4](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/4))

  Screens that name who did something, such as the laboratory profile and the "Recorded by" column of correction histories, now show the account's current display name instead of its internal ID. A renamed account shows its new name everywhere.

  Technical notes:

  Stored records keep only the immutable user ID; the engine resolves names on each read, so no migration is needed. Affected views gain `*_display` fields.

- **Fixed:** macOS app bundle passes signature verification (2026-10-22, [#3](https://github.com/openbga/toxicology-lims/pull/3))

  The macOS download now carries an ad hoc signature that seals the whole application bundle, so it no longer reports a damaged signature. macOS still asks for a Gatekeeper exception because the publisher is not identified.

  Technical notes:

  Tauri's macOS signing identity is set to ad hoc (`-`), and the package workflow rejects a build whose app fails `codesign --verify --deep --strict`. Developer ID signing and notarization are not part of this change.
